B1_name_collision.fix: render_batch namespaces every generated theorem under a per-batch secret nonce (pf<nonce>_name); parse_summary refuses any summary row whose name does not bear the nonce. env.contains can then only be true for a constant THIS batch declared, so a goal named to collide with a Mathlib constant is declared+looked-up under its own nonce name and the pre-existing constant is never consulted.
B1_name_collision.type_is_intended: Guaranteed by construction: Lean elaborates `theorem pf<nonce>_name : STATEMENT := by PROOF`, so if the nonce-named constant exists its type IS the written statement; the nonce closes the only gap (looking up a different, pre-existing constant).

B2_summary_spoofing.fix: summary framed by nonce-bearing PF_BEGIN_<nonce>/PF_END_<nonce>; parse only inside the frame; frame must appear exactly once; every expected name exactly once; duplicates/extras/missing -> None (untrusted); rows must bear the nonce.

B3_parser_fuzz.fix: parse_summary hardened; fuzz over {0,1,many axioms} x {PRESENT,MISSING} x whitespace/CRLF/trailing-tab x unicode names (seeded, 400 trials).

B4_canaries.fix: every batch carries 5 mandatory canaries with MEASURED real-toolchain axiom sets: true(omega->propext,Quot.sound/PROVEN), false(omega fails/NOT_PROVEN), zero(True by trivial -> EMPTY axioms/PROVEN -> forces the trailing-tab line into every batch), sorry(sorryAx/NOT_PROVEN), stdax(Classical.em->propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound/PROVEN). Any canary misread -> whole batch untrusted.

B5_split_bisection.termination: verify().solve halves the chunk on distrust; base case len==1 -> singleton; recursion depth <= log2(max_batch); always terminates.
B5_split_bisection.singleton_untrusted: a singleton that is still untrusted -> UNKNOWN, never PROVEN.

B6_timeouts.fix: runner timeout -> _timed_group_run kills the whole process group -> no trustworthy summary -> UNKNOWN; no orphans.

B7_axiom_whitelist.fix: ALLOWED_AXIOMS == {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} exactly; anything else (sorryAx or custom) -> NOT_PROVEN.

B8_why_tab_bug_was_missed.root_cause: v1.4.6 parse_summary used raw.strip(), which eats the TRAILING TAB of a zero-axiom PROVEN line 'name\tPRESENT\t' -> 2 columns -> whole batch untrusted.
B8_why_tab_bug_was_missed.why_all_probes_missed_it: The bug only manifests on an EMPTY-axiom PRESENT line. That line only appears for a proof that uses ZERO axioms (e.g. `trivial`/`rfl`). MEASURED: omega proofs carry {propext,Quot.sound} (non-empty), Classical.em carries 3 axioms. Every v1.4.6 probe, selftest-170, p1-p4, and the original 18 tests used ONLY omega goals (and omega canaries) -> never a zero-axiom provable goal -> the trailing-tab line was never produced -> the bug was dormant.
B8_why_tab_bug_was_missed.why_caught_now: B4's mandatory zero-axiom canary forces the 'name\tPRESENT\t' line into EVERY batch; B3's fuzz includes the {0 axioms} x trailing-tab case directly.
regression_demo: test_b8_canary_zero_would_break_every_batch_under_old_parser (reintroduces raw.strip() and shows it drops the batch while the current parser does not)

R2_supervisor.impl: pf_trust/supervise.py: run_resumable/supervise_once run jobs in their own session (start_new_session=True), enforce a wall-clock limit, monitor a heartbeat file (Heartbeat.beat, atomic), kill the whole group on stall (default 10 min) or timeout, and resume from the job's checkpoint. Integer-second timing only.
